textbookText: A. Tick the correct alternatives: 1. Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of prokaryotic cells? a. Lack of organized nucleus b. Presence of membrane-bound organelles c. Naked circular DNA d. 70s ribosomes 2. Which of the following organelles is not membrane bound? e. Centriole f. Chloroplast g. Plastid h. Ribosome 3. How would you describe the property of the cell membrane? a. Semipermeable b. Permeable c. Nonpermeable d. Impermeable 4. What term describes the protoplasmic connection between two cells? a. Plasmodesmata b. Semipermeable c. Cell wall d. None 5. According to the fluid-Mosaic Model, which type of proteins are embedded within the phospholipid bilayer? a. peripheral proteins b. Extrinsic proteins c. Integral proteins d. Globular proteins 6. Which process involves the expulsion of large sized materials from the cell through the cell membrane? a. Endocytosis b. Exocytosis c. Osmosis d. Diffusion 7. What enzyme is responsible for controlling the synthesis of ATP in mitochondria? a. ATPase b. ATP synthetase c. Oxidase d. Ribonuclease 8. Chromosomes with a centromere located near the middle are classified as? a. Metacentric b. Sub-metacentric Biology, Grade 11 | 61

c. Acrocentric d. Telocentric 9. What is the primary function of mesosomes in prokaryotic cells? e. Photosynthesis f. Respiration g. Protein synthesis h. Cell division 10. Which type of ribosome is found in the cytoplasm of eukaryotic cells? i. 70s j. 80s k. 60s l. 30s 11. What type of endoplasmic reticulum (ER) is primarily involved in lipid synthesis? a. Granular Endoplasmic Reticulum (GER) b. Rough Endoplasmic Reticulum (RER) c. Smooth Endoplasmic Reticulum (SER) d. Nuclear Endoplasmic Reticulum (NER)
12. Which structure in the Golgi complex is responsible for modifying, packaging, and transporting proteins and lipids? e. Lysosomes f. Ribosomes g. Cisternae h. Tubules
13. Which of the following is NOT a function of lysosomes? a. Digestion of extracellular food content b. Synthesis of lipids c. Autophagy d. Release of digestive enzymes during fertilization
14. Which pigment is found in chloroplasts? a. Carotene b. Chlorophyll c. Xanthophyll d. Phycocyanin
15. Which type of plastid is involved in photosynthesis? e. Chromoplast f. Leucoplast g. Chloroplast h. Amyloplast
